verdict.rationale: GitLab documents an official, semantically versioned REST API v4 with deprecation guidance. It also publishes an autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec in its monorepo, which developers can use to generate their own clients. Nothing in the evidence names official first-party language SDKs, so building against the API means generating or hand-writing clients rather than using vendor-maintained SDKs. Missing for 10: documented official language SDKs/client libraries, SDK reference docs, independent corroboration of SDK use.
